# Launch checklist: <game name>

Used at G4 launch readiness. Every box needs a link or a name next to it.

## Quality
- [ ] Zero open S1 and S2 bugs
- [ ] Performance bar passed on every device in the matrix
- [ ] Security pass done, every remote fuzzed
- [ ] Data pass done: session locking, retries, a migration tested on old saves
- [ ] Full regression pass on staging

## Compliance
- [ ] Maturity and compliance questionnaire filled in and accurate
- [ ] All user-written text filtered
- [ ] Odds shown and PolicyService gating on any paid random items
- [ ] Community Standards review of every asset, text string and sound

## Store and monetization
- [ ] Icon, thumbnails and description, checked on a phone
- [ ] Passes and products priced and tested with real purchases on staging
- [ ] ProcessReceipt grants each purchase exactly once

## Operations
- [ ] Analytics funnel verified with real events
- [ ] Error logging in place, with someone watching it in the first week
- [ ] Rollback plan: the version to revert to, and who does it
- [ ] Soft-launch ad budget and the KPI thresholds that unlock more spend
- [ ] Group, social links and a support channel ready
